from typing import Any, Mapping, Sequence


def format_results_table(rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> str:
    """Format retraining results as a Markdown table.

    Expected row keys can include: run_id, dataset, metric, value, score.
    Missing keys are rendered as empty strings.
    """
    columns = ["run_id", "dataset", "metric", "value", "score"]
    header = "| " + " | ".join(columns) + " |"
    separator = "| " + " | ".join(["---"] * len(columns)) + " |"
    body = []
    for row in rows:
        body.append("| " + " | ".join(str(row.get(col, "")) for col in columns) + " |")
    return "\n".join([header, separator] + body)
